# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_DRY_UP

**Filed:** 2026-08-18  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a gap up, if opening volume fails to sustain and price retests VWAP from above with a bearish candle, the gap is likely to fade. This strategy captures the fade by entering short on weak volume and VWAP rejection, exploiting the mean-reversion tendency when initial gap momentum lacks conviction.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If gap_up > 0.3% (open > prior day high) AND volume_first_15min < 0.7 * average_volume_first_15min_prior_5days AND price crosses below VWAP with close < open AND EMA(8) < EMA(21), enter short at close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Stop at gap high (prior day high), TP1 at 1.5R (risk-reward), runner using structure invalidation (break above prior day high).  
**Regime filters:** Only trade when VIX < 20 and time between 09:45-10:15 ET; avoid days where ATR(5) > 0.5% of price.
